definition_zh: 允许；许可；正式批准；书面批文；权限
definition_en: the act of allowing someone to do something, or the official right to do it that an authority grants
core_image: 一把钥匙被放进掌心：门还锁着，但你已经有权把它推开
scene: 美术馆的展厅里，讲解员把三脚架拦在门外，指着墙上一行小字提醒参观者。Photographs are allowed only with written permission from the museum.
sceneCN: 这里是「正式许可、批准」（第 2 个义项：机构给出的正式准许）；句意为只有拿到博物馆的书面许可才能拍照。画面的重点是门口被拦下的三脚架和墙上那行小字。

pos.zh: 允许；许可；批准；书面批文；权限

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁词干 permiss- 加 -ive 构成，义为「宽容的；放任的」
由同一词干加 -ible 构成，义为「可允许的；容许的」
与 permission 同出拉丁语 permittere，作动词指「允许」，作名词指「许可证」；两者同源但不是同一词的词形变化
由 permissive 加 -ness 构成，义为「宽容；放任」

senses.title: The act of allowing someone to do something
senses.definition: the act of agreeing that someone may do something, without necessarily putting it in writing
senses.definitionCN: 同意某人可以做某事的行为，不一定落实为文字
senses.example: She gave me permission to use her desk while she was away.
senses.exampleCN: 她不在的时候允许我用她的桌子。
senses.why: Latin permittere joins per-, through, with mittere, to send or let go; the idea is letting something pass out of your control.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 permittere 由表示「穿过」的 per- 与表示「送出、放开」的 mittere 合成，本义是让某件事从自己的掌控中放行，所以这个词天生带着点头放人的动作感。

senses.title: Official authorization from an authority
senses.definition: the official right to do something that a person or body in authority gives you
senses.definitionCN: 由有权的个人或机构给予的做某事的正式权利
senses.example: No one may film inside the court without permission from the judge.
senses.exampleCN: 未经法官批准，任何人不得在法庭内拍摄。
senses.why: Once the letting-through happens inside an institution, the same noun names the authorization the body issues rather than a private nod.
senses.whyCN: 当「放行」发生在机构内部，这个名词就从私人的点头变成了机构发出的授权，因此在规章语境里它几乎等同于批准。

senses.title: A written or formal grant, often countable
senses.definition: a formal document or stated allowance that records the right to do something
senses.definitionCN: 记录做某事权利的正式文件或明确许可
senses.example: The crew needed three separate permissions to shut the street for a night.
senses.exampleCN: 摄制组需要三份不同的批文才能封街一夜。
senses.why: Permission can be counted when the thing counted is not the consent itself but the separate grants, one for each activity.
senses.whyCN: 当被计数的不是「同意」本身，而是逐项开出的批文时，permission 就可以数了，一次活动一份，于是出现复数形式。

senses.title: Access rights inside a computer system
senses.definition: the rights that control what a user may read, change or delete on a computer system
senses.definitionCN: 控制用户在计算机系统中可以读取、修改或删除哪些内容的权利
senses.example: The folder refuses to open until an administrator changes its permissions.
senses.exampleCN: 在管理员更改文件夹权限之前，它打不开。
senses.why: Computing borrowed the institutional sense literally: the system checks whether your account has been let through to a file.
senses.whyCN: 计算机几乎是照搬机构义的逻辑：系统检查你的账号是否被放行到某个文件，于是同一个词变成了权限设置。

intro.en: Permission descends from Latin permissio, the action noun of permittere; it shares that verb with the English verb permit but is not the verb plus a suffix.
intro.cn: permission 源自拉丁语 permissio，那是动词 permittere 的动作名词；它与英语动词 permit 共享同一个拉丁动词，并不是由 permit 直接加后缀变来的。

items.en: Mittere meant to send or to let go, and it lies under a large Latin family of release and sending.
items.cn: mittere 意为送出、放开，许多表示释放与送出的拉丁词都由它衍生。

items.en: Adding per-, through, produced permittere, to let something pass through, and therefore to allow it.
items.cn: 加上表示「穿过」的 per-，构成 permittere：让某物通过，因而引申为允许。

items.en: The action noun permissio named the letting-through itself and is the direct source of the English noun.
items.cn: 动作名词 permissio 指放行这件事本身，是英语名词的直接来源。

items.en: Old French carried the noun as permission and handed it to Middle English in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 古法语以 permission 的形式承接这个名词，并在十四世纪交给中古英语。

items.en: English kept the noun for consent, later allowed countable grants, and in the twentieth century added computer access rights.
items.cn: 英语保留名词表示同意的用法，后来发展出可数的批文义，二十世纪又添上计算机访问权一义。

note.en: The first group collects words built on the same Latin verb of letting through; the second collects words about consent, approval and access.
note.cn: 第一组收同一个拉丁动词派生出的词；第二组收表示同意、批准与准入的词。

entries.definition: The verb, and separately the noun for a licence, both built on Latin permittere.
entries.definitionCN: 直接建于拉丁语 permittere 之上的动词，以及另一个表示许可证的名词。

entries.definition: Allowing a lot of freedom and not punishing behaviour strictly.
entries.definitionCN: 给予很大自由、不严格约束行为的；宽容的。

entries.definition: Allowed by a rule or by law.
entries.definitionCN: 规则或法律所允许的。

entries.definition: A task someone is sent to carry out, from the Latin verb of sending.
entries.definitionCN: 派某人去完成的任务，出自同一个表示送出的拉丁动词。

entries.definition: Agreement to something happening, given by someone free to refuse.
entries.definitionCN: 对某事发生的同意，由有权拒绝的人给出。

entries.definition: Official power or approval to act, usually written down.
entries.definitionCN: 行动的正式权力或批准，通常见诸文字。

entries.definition: Official permission to go ahead, especially after a check.
entries.definitionCN: 尤指经审查后获得的继续进行的正式许可。

entries.definition: A document that allows an activity, usually paid for.
entries.definitionCN: 允许某项活动的证件，通常需要付费取得。

normalIntro.en: The word is held together by a Latin verb of letting through, and its relatives keep returning to gates, grants and keys.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词靠一个表示放行的拉丁动词支撑，同族词反复回到门禁、批文与钥匙上。

normal.en: Per- means through in Latin, so permission is literally a letting-through: the gate opens and you walk in.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 per- 意为穿过，所以 permission 字面上就是放行：门开了，你走进去。

normal.en: The noun keeps the miss- stem of mittere, to send; the same stem hides in mission and in the verb permit.
normal.cn: 这个名词保留了 mittere（送出）的 miss- 词干，同一词干也藏在 mission 与动词 permit 里。

normal.en: You ask for permission and you receive permission, and those two verbs box in most of its everyday use.
normal.cn: 请求许可、获得许可，这一对动词几乎框住了它在日常里的全部用法。

normal.en: Without permission and with permission are fixed pairs, and the noun after with takes no article.
normal.cn: 未经许可与经许可都是固定搭配，with 后面直接跟不带冠词的名词。

normal.en: Spoken English often prefers to say that someone is allowed to do something, while written rules prefer the noun.
normal.cn: 口语常说某人被允许做某事，而书面规章更偏爱这个名词。

abstract.en: Permission is a door held open by someone else: the room was always there, but you could not enter until that hand moved.
abstract.cn: permission 是别人替你扶住的门：房间一直在那里，可那只手不动，你就进不去。

abstract.en: The word measures the distance between wanting to do something and being entitled to do it.
abstract.cn: 这个词量出的，是想做某件事与有权做某件事之间的距离。

abstract.en: Inside a computer the same idea becomes a switch: access is either granted or refused, with nothing in between.
abstract.cn: 在计算机里，同一个念头变成一个开关：访问权要么被授予，要么被拒绝，中间没有余地。

examples.en: Nobody leaves the base without written permission.
examples.cn: 没有书面许可，谁也不能离开基地。

examples.en: The council finally gave permission for the market to reopen.
examples.cn: 市政会终于批准市场重新开放。

examples.en: She was refused permission to sit the exam early.
examples.cn: 她提前参加考试的申请被拒绝了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「怕米审」——想从米仓取米，得先过一道审查，怕米审不过就一粒也拿不走；permission 就是许可。

root: 拉丁语 permittere（per- 穿过 + mittere 送出）意为放行、允许，其名词形 permissio 经古法语 permission 进入英语；同族词多与送出、放行有关。

sensesIntro.en: From a private nod to an official grant and then to a line of code, the word keeps one idea: something is let through.
sensesIntro.cn: 从私人的点头到机构的批准，再到一行代码，这个词始终守着一个意思：某样东西被放行了。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a key placed in your palm while the door stays shut until you turn it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把钥匙被放进掌心，门还锁着，等你转动手腕。

branches.en: a friend nodding so you may borrow the chair
branches.cn: 朋友点头，你才把那把椅子搬走

branches.en: a signature at the bottom of an official form
branches.cn: 公文末尾的一个签名

branches.en: the same yes, spoken once and printed once
branches.cn: 同一个「可以」，一次说出口，一次印成纸

branches.en: a locked folder waiting for an administrator
branches.cn: 一个锁着的文件夹等着管理员

branches.en: a gate, whether of wood or of software
branches.cn: 一道门，木头做的或软件做的都一样

intro.en: A Latin prefix of passage, a Latin verb of sending and a noun ending that turns the act into a thing hold the word together.
intro.cn: 表示穿过的拉丁前缀、表示送出的拉丁动词，以及把动作变成名词的词尾，共同撑起这个词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is well recorded: mittere, permittere and permissio all survive inside English borrowings.
latinIntro.cn: 这一族的拉丁词有清楚记录：mittere、permittere、permissio 都通过借词留在了英语里。

definition_zh: 允许；准许；使成为可能；许可证；执照
definition_en: to allow something to happen or someone to do something; also an official document that gives you the right to do something
core_image: 一只手在闸机旁按下按钮，横杆抬起，让一个人走过去
scene: 停车场入口的栏杆旁，管理员把一张塑封卡片放在挡风玻璃后面，示意司机可以开进去了。A resident permit lets you park here all year.
sceneCN: 这里是名词「许可证」（第 4 个义项：官方发放、允许持有人在特定范围内活动的证件）；句意为有了居民停车证，就能整年停在这里。画面里是挡风玻璃后的那张卡。

derivatives.zh: 由同一拉丁动词 permittere 的动作名词 permissio 演变而来，义为「许可」；与 permit 同源，名词形式不同
由词干 permiss- 加 -ive 构成，义为「宽容的；放任的」
由词干 permiss- 加 -ible 构成，义为「可允许的」

senses.title: To allow someone to do something
senses.definition: to give someone the right to do something, especially through an authority or a rule
senses.definitionCN: 尤指通过权威或规则给予某人做某事的权利
senses.example: The library does not permit food or drink at the desks.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆不允许在桌边吃东西或喝饮料。
senses.why: Latin permittere is per-, through, plus mittere, to let go: the word begins as a physical letting-through and ends as a social yes.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 permittere 是 per-（穿过）加 mittere（放开），本义是让某物通过，后来才转成社会意义上的点头同意。

senses.title: To make something possible
senses.definition: to make an action possible, said of conditions such as weather, time or money
senses.definitionCN: 使某个行动成为可能，多就天气、时间、金钱等条件而言
senses.example: The narrow road did not permit two cars to pass.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路太窄，两辆车过不去。
senses.why: If a condition lets an action pass through, the same verb naturally comes to mean that the condition makes the action possible.
senses.whyCN: 如果某个条件让一个动作通过，这个动词自然就表示条件使动作成为可能，这就是从允许到使得以的那一步。

senses.title: To authorize formally, as a body does
senses.definition: to give official approval for an activity, often in writing
senses.definitionCN: 对某项活动给予正式批准，常为书面形式
senses.example: The city permitted the closure of two lanes for repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 市政部门批准封闭两条车道进行维修。
senses.why: Institutions need a word for the official version of yes and took over the verb that already meant letting through.
senses.whyCN: 机构需要一个表示官方同意的词，就直接沿用本来表示放行的这个动词，正式批准义由此而来。

senses.title: An official document allowing an activity
senses.definition: an official document that allows you to do something or to go somewhere
senses.definitionCN: 允许你做某事或去某处的正式证件
senses.example: He was stopped at the gate because his permit had expired.
senses.exampleCN: 他在门口被拦下，因为他的许可证过期了。
senses.why: English turned the verb into a countable noun in the nineteenth century, so the permission itself became a piece of paper you carry.
senses.whyCN: 十九世纪英语把这个动词转成可数名词，那份允许于是变成一张随身携带的纸，这就是许可证义的来路。

intro.en: Permit comes straight from Latin permittere, to let through; the noun use is a later English reuse of the same form.
intro.cn: permit 直接来自拉丁语 permittere（放行、允许）；名词用法是同一个词形在英语里后起的转用。

items.en: Mittere meant to send or to release and supplied the core of many Latin verbs of letting go.
items.cn: mittere 意为送出、放开，是许多表示放手的拉丁动词的核心。

items.en: Per- added the idea of passage, giving permittere, to let something go through.
items.cn: 加上表示通过的 per-，构成 permittere，意为让某物穿过去。

items.en: The noun permissio grew up beside the verb and named the act of letting through.
items.cn: 名词 permissio 与动词并行发展，用来指放行这件事。

items.en: English borrowed the verb in the fifteenth century, at first in legal and official writing.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入这个动词，最早见于法律与公文。

items.en: The countable noun for a licence appears in the nineteenth century, and compounds such as work permit follow.
items.cn: 表示许可证的可数名词在十九世纪出现，工作许可证一类的复合词随之而来。

note.en: The look-alike group holds relatives of the same Latin verb; the near-meaning group holds verbs and nouns of consent and official leave.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁动词的同族词；近义组收表示同意与官方放行的动词和名词。

entries.definition: The action noun of the same Latin verb; unlike permit, it is almost always uncountable.
entries.definitionCN: 同一拉丁动词的动作名词；与 permit 不同，它几乎总是不可数。

entries.definition: Allowing much freedom and not imposing strict limits.
entries.definitionCN: 给予很大自由、不施加严格限制的。

entries.definition: Allowed by a rule, a law or a standard.
entries.definitionCN: 规则、法律或标准所允许的。

entries.definition: A task given to someone and sent with them, from the Latin verb of sending.
entries.definitionCN: 交给某人并随之前往的任务，出自表示送出的拉丁动词。

entries.definition: To let something happen without opposing it, the most general verb of this kind.
entries.definitionCN: 不加以反对地让某事发生，是这类动词中最通用的一个。

entries.definition: To give official power or approval for an action.
entries.definitionCN: 为某项行动给予正式权力或批准。

entries.definition: A document that allows an activity, usually after payment and checks.
entries.definitionCN: 允许某项活动的证件，通常需付费并通过审查。

entries.definition: To allow something, used above all in everyday speech.
entries.definitionCN: 允许某事，主要用于日常口语。

normalIntro.en: One Latin verb of letting through gives both the act of allowing and the card that proves it.
normalIntro.cn: 同一个表示放行的拉丁动词，既给出允许这个动作，也给出证明允许的那张卡。

normal.en: Mittere is to send, so to permit is to send something on its way instead of stopping it.
normal.cn: mittere 是送出，所以 permit 是把事情放它走，而不是把它拦住。

normal.en: The past tense doubles the t: permitted, because the stress rests on the final syllable.
normal.cn: 过去式双写 t 写作 permitted，因为重音压在最后一个音节上。

normal.en: As a verb the stress falls on the second syllable, as a noun it moves to the first.
normal.cn: 作动词时重音在第二音节，作名词时移到第一音节。

normal.en: Weather permitting is a fixed absolute phrase meaning if the weather allows it.
normal.cn: 天气允许的话是固定的独立结构，意思是如果天气条件许可。

normal.en: A work permit, a parking permit and a residence permit are all papers, not acts of allowing.
normal.cn: 工作许可证、停车证、居留许可，说的都是纸面证件，而不是允许这个动作。

abstract.en: A permit is a small rectangle of card standing in for a person's word, so the gate trusts the paper rather than you.
abstract.cn: permit 是一小张纸卡，代替某个人的口头承诺，于是闸机信的是纸，不是你。

abstract.en: To permit is to step aside: the verb describes not doing something, and that is its whole content.
abstract.cn: 允许就是往旁边让一步；这个动词描述的是一种不作为，它的全部内容就在这里。

abstract.en: Every permit carries a boundary, saying how long and how far, which is why a licence can expire.
abstract.cn: 每一张许可证都带着边界，说明多久、多远，所以证件才会过期。

examples.en: Smoking is not permitted anywhere inside the building.
examples.cn: 楼内任何地方都不准吸烟。

examples.en: If the weather permits, we will hold the ceremony outside.
examples.cn: 如果天气允许，我们会在户外举行仪式。

examples.en: Her permit allows her to work in the country for two years.
examples.cn: 她的许可证允许她在这个国家工作两年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泼米特」——闸机前有人泼了一地米，特批之后才放你过去；permit 就是允许。

root: 拉丁语 permittere（per- 穿过 + mittere 送出）意为放行、允许；名词 permit 是英语后起的转用，与 permission 同源而词形不同。

sensesIntro.en: One Latin verb of letting through supplies both the act of allowing and the paper that proves it.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个表示放行的拉丁动词，既提供了允许这个动作，也提供了证明允许的那张纸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pressing the button beside a barrier so that the bar lifts and someone walks through.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手在闸机旁按下按钮，横杆抬起，让一个人走过去。

branches.en: a barrier lifting for one person
branches.cn: 横杆为一个人抬起

branches.en: a narrow lane where two cars cannot meet
branches.cn: 窄路上两车无法交会

branches.en: a signed order closing two lanes
branches.cn: 一纸批准封闭两条车道的公文

branches.en: a card checked at a gate
branches.cn: 在门口被查验的一张卡

branches.en: the same yes spoken once and printed once
branches.cn: 同一个「可以」，一次说出口，一次印在纸上

intro.en: The word rests on a Latin prefix of passage, a Latin verb of sending, and an English habit of turning verbs into countable nouns.
intro.cn: 这个词靠表示穿过的拉丁前缀、表示送出的拉丁动词，以及英语把动词转成可数名词的习惯支撑。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ancestry is recorded without gaps: mittere, permittere and permissio all survive in English borrowings.
latinIntro.cn: 这一支的拉丁来历有完整记录：mittere、permittere、permissio 都以借词形式留在英语里。

definition_zh: 坚持；持续；执意；存留；持久化
definition_en: to keep doing something despite difficulty, or to continue to exist beyond the expected time
core_image: 一个人站在原地不动，风一直吹，他始终没退一步。
scene: 他退烧之后，咳嗽又持续了三个星期。The cough persisted for three weeks after the fever cleared.
sceneCN: 这里 persist 是「（症状）持续不退」（第 3 个义项：病症延续）；句意：退烧之后，咳嗽还持续了三周。场景要点：药瓶、日历上划掉的日期、仍在咳的人；对应第 1 个义项。

derivatives.zh: 坚持不懈的；持续的；顽固的
非持久的（多用于计算机或化学语境）

senses.title: Keep going despite difficulty
senses.definition: to continue an effort even when it is hard or slow to succeed
senses.definitionCN: 即使困难或见效缓慢，仍继续努力
senses.example: She persisted with the experiment after four failed trials.
senses.exampleCN: 四次试验失败后，她仍坚持做这个实验。
senses.why: Latin sistere meant 'to stand firm, take a stand'. Persist is per- 'thoroughly' + sistere: to stand your ground all the way through.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 sistere 意为“站稳、站定”。persist 是 per-“彻底”+ sistere：从头到尾站住不退。

senses.title: Continue to exist
senses.definition: of a condition, practice, or thing, to continue to exist over time
senses.definitionCN: 指某种状况、做法或事物随时间继续存在
senses.example: The custom persists in rural areas.
senses.exampleCN: 这一习俗在农村地区仍然存在。
senses.why: The standing image is applied to existence itself: something that stands does not fall away, so it keeps being there.
senses.whyCN: “站住”的意象被用在存在本身：站住的东西不会倒掉，因此一直还在。

senses.title: Of a symptom: fail to clear
senses.definition: of an illness or symptom, to continue longer than expected
senses.definitionCN: 指疾病或症状持续的时间超过预期
senses.example: See a doctor if the fever persists for more than three days.
senses.exampleCN: 如果发烧持续超过三天，请就医。
senses.why: A symptom is something standing in the body that refuses to leave. The verb marks duration, not effort, which is why medical usage is so common.
senses.whyCN: 症状是站在身体里不肯走的东西。这个动词标记的是“时程”而非“努力”，所以医学用法很常见。

senses.title: Of a smell or trace: remain
senses.definition: of a smell, taste, impression, or mark, to remain after its source has gone
senses.definitionCN: 指气味、味道、印象或痕迹在来源消失后仍然留着
senses.example: The smell of smoke persisted in the curtains for days.
senses.exampleCN: 烟味在窗帘上留了好几天。
senses.why: The trace keeps standing in the material even after the fire is out. Persistence here is physical stubbornness.
senses.whyCN: 火灭了，痕迹仍站在布料里。这里的持续，是一种物理上的不肯走。

senses.title: Keep asking or doing, annoyingly
senses.definition: to continue doing or asking something in a way that others find hard to stop
senses.definitionCN: 以别人难以阻止的方式反复做或反复问
senses.example: He persisted in calling until she answered.
senses.exampleCN: 他一直打个不停，直到她接电话。
senses.why: The same standing firm can be read from outside as refusal to take no for an answer. The virtue turns into a nuisance.
senses.whyCN: 同一个“站住”，从外面看就是不肯接受“不”。美德由此变成了烦扰。

senses.title: Of a belief or institution: survive
senses.titleCN: 观念延续：穿过年代还在
senses.definition: of a belief, institution, or idea, to survive over a long time
senses.definitionCN: 指信念、制度或观念长期存续下来
senses.example: The belief persisted long after the empire fell.
senses.exampleCN: 帝国灭亡很久之后，这种信仰仍然延续。
senses.why: Institutions stand longer than the people who hold them up. Persistence becomes a measure of historical survival.
senses.whyCN: 制度比撑着它的人站得更久。持续由此成为衡量历史存活的尺度。

senses.title: Computing: store data permanently
senses.definition: of data, to remain stored after a program or device stops running
senses.definitionCN: 指数据在程序或设备停止运行后仍然保留
senses.example: The settings persist even after a restart.
senses.exampleCN: 即使重启，设置也会保留。
senses.why: Memory that vanishes is data that could not stand. Persistent storage is the technical version of 'still standing after the power goes off'.
senses.whyCN: 一断电就消失的记忆，是站不住的数据。持久化存储，就是“断电后仍站着”的技术版本。

senses.title: Insist stubbornly against advice
senses.definition: to continue in a course of action in spite of warnings or good advice
senses.definitionCN: 不顾警告或善意劝告，继续照自己的做法行事
senses.example: He persisted in driving despite the closed-road signs.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有封路标志，他仍执意开车。
senses.why: Standing firm with no reason to stand is stubbornness. The word does not judge by itself; the context decides whether to praise or blame.
senses.whyCN: 没有理由还站着，就是固执。这个词本身不作评判，是语境决定该夸还是该责。

intro.en: Persist is Latin per- 'thoroughly' + sistere 'to stand firm', from the same Indo-European root as stand. The core is not effort but posture: staying on your feet.
intro.cn: persist 是拉丁语 per-“彻底”+ sistere“站稳”，与 stand 同出一个印欧词根。它的核心不是努力，而是姿态：站住不倒。

items.en: The root *sta- gives Latin stare 'to stand', sistere 'cause to stand', and English stand, stable, statue, and constant.
items.cn: 词根 *sta- 衍生出拉丁语 stare“站”、sistere“使站住”，以及英语 stand、stable、statue、constant。

items.en: Sistere meant 'to cause to stand, place, stop'. Its frequentative form was used for holding a position, which is the seed of 'persist'.
items.cn: sistere 意为“使站住、安置、停住”。它的反复形式用于“守住位置”，这正是 persist 的种子。

items.en: Persistere combined per- 'through, thoroughly' with sistere: 'to continue standing, persevere, persist'.
items.cn: persistere 把 per-“贯穿、彻底”与 sistere 结合：“一直站住、坚持、持续”。

items.en: English records persist in the 1530s, first of persons continuing in a course, then of things continuing to exist.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪 30 年代记录 persist，先指人继续走某条路，后指事物继续存在。

items.en: The medical sense of a symptom that will not clear and the physical sense of a smell that remains both grow from the same 'still standing' image.
items.cn: 症状不退的医学义与气味残留的物理义，都从同一个“仍站着”的意象长出来。

items.en: Persistent storage and persistent data apply the old verb to memory that survives a restart. Persistence becomes a technical property.
items.cn: persistent storage 与 persistent data 把这个老动词用在重启后仍存活的内存上。持续由此成为一种技术属性。

note.en: The first group is the persist family plus the Latin verb behind it; the second separates near-synonyms by what exactly keeps going.
note.cn: 第一组是 persist 词族及其背后的拉丁动词；第二组按“究竟是什么在继续”区分近义词。

entries.definition: the quality of continuing despite difficulty, or of lasting. It is the noun of persist.
entries.definitionCN: 尽管困难仍继续的品质，或持久性。它是 persist 的名词。

entries.definition: continuing firmly or lasting a long time. It describes the person or thing, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 坚持不懈的；持续时间长的。它描述人或物，而非动作。

entries.definition: a rarer synonym of persistence, used especially in older technical writing.
entries.definitionCN: persistence 的较罕见同义词，多用于较早的技术文献。

entries.definition: not lasting, used of chemicals that break down quickly and of network connections that close after use.
entries.definitionCN: 不持久的，用于快速降解的化学品，或用完即关闭的网络连接。

entries.definition: to keep trying despite difficulty. It is close to persist but almost always about deliberate human effort toward a goal.
entries.definitionCN: 尽管困难仍不断尝试。它与 persist 接近，但几乎总指人为目标付出的努力。

entries.definition: to keep happening or doing without stopping. It is the neutral word and carries no idea of resistance.
entries.definitionCN: 不停地继续发生或做。它最中性，不含抵抗之意。

entries.definition: to suffer something difficult patiently, or to last a long time. It adds the weight of suffering or durability.
entries.definitionCN: 耐心承受艰难，或长久存在。它加了受苦或耐久的分量。

entries.definition: to stay longer than expected, often unwillingly. It is used of smells, illness, and people who should go.
entries.definitionCN: 比预期停留更久，常含不愿离开。它用于气味、疾病与该走的人。

entries.definition: to demand something firmly. It is about a claim or demand, while persist is about continuing an action.
entries.definitionCN: 坚决要求。它关于主张或要求，而 persist 关于继续行动。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and relatives: Latin per- 'thoroughly' + sistere 'stand firm', from PIE *sta- 'stand'. Family words persistence, persistent, persistently; relatives stand, stable, statue, constant.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与同族词：拉丁语 per-“彻底”+ sistere“站稳”，源自原始印欧语 *sta-“站”。词族为 persistence、persistent、persistently；亲属词 stand、stable、statue、constant。

normal.en: Sistere is 'stand firm'; persist is standing firm all the way through.
normal.cn: sistere 是“站稳”；persist 就是从头到尾一直站稳。

normal.en: Stand, stable, statue, constant, persist: one *sta- family of standing.
normal.cn: stand、stable、statue、constant、persist：同一个 *sta-“站立”家族。

normal.en: A persistent cough is a cough that will not stand down.
normal.cn: persistent cough 就是不肯“退下”的咳嗽。

normal.en: Persistent data is data still standing after the power is cut.
normal.cn: persistent data 就是断电后仍站着的数据。

normal.en: Persist in and persist with are both about refusing to leave the spot.
normal.cn: persist in 与 persist with，都是不肯离开那个位置。

abstract.en: Persistence is often just the decision to remain where the difficulty is.
abstract.cn: 坚持，常常只是决定留在困难所在的那个地方。

abstract.en: What persists shapes the world more than what is intense.
abstract.cn: 留下来的东西，比强烈的东西更能塑造世界。

abstract.en: To persist is to make time your ally rather than your judge.
abstract.cn: 坚持，就是把时间变成盟友，而不是法官。

examples.en: The team persisted through two years of rejected applications.
examples.cn: 团队在两年申请被拒的情况下仍坚持下来。

examples.en: Old farming methods persist in the valley.
examples.cn: 古老的耕作方式在山谷里仍然延续。

examples.en: The rash persisted after the course of antibiotics ended.
examples.cn: 抗生素疗程结束后，皮疹仍未消退。

dict_mnemonic.text: “破吸石”——破吸盘还能吸在石头上不掉，风再大也不松 → persist 坚持、持续

root: 源自拉丁语 persistere“一直站住、坚持”，由 per-“贯穿、彻底”+ sistere“站稳、使站住”构成；sistere 与 stare“站”同出原始印欧语 *sta-“站”，故与 stand、stable、statue、constant 同源。核心是“站住不倒”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of persist, all one posture: something stays standing when it could have fallen, stopped, or gone away.
sensesIntro.cn: persist 的八个义项是同一个姿态：本可以倒下、停止或离开的东西，仍然站着。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure standing in wind, feet planted, not moving back.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在风里，双脚钉住，不退一步。

branches.en: WILL: effort and stubbornness are the same posture seen from inside and from outside.
branches.cn: 意志：努力与固执，是同一个姿态从里面和外面看的样子。

branches.en: EXISTENCE: a custom or belief stands longer than the people holding it up.
branches.cn: 存在：习俗或信仰，比撑着它的人站得更久。

branches.en: TRACES: a symptom and a smell both stay in the body or the cloth after their cause is gone.
branches.cn: 痕迹：症状与气味，都在成因消失后仍留在身体或布料里。

branches.en: PRESSURE: asking again and again is standing firm in someone else's doorway.
branches.cn: 压力：一遍遍追问，就是在别人的门口站住不走。

branches.en: MACHINES: persistent storage is memory that survives the power being switched off.
branches.cn: 机器：持久化存储，是断电后仍存活的内存。

intro.en: Persist's family is built on Latin sistere 'to stand firm'. Suffixes mark the state, the person or thing, and the manner; non- removes the lasting.
intro.cn: persist 的词族建立在拉丁语 sistere“站稳”上。后缀标记状态、人与方式；non- 则取消“持久”。

latinIntro.en: The reliable forms are stare 'to stand', sistere 'cause to stand', and persistere 'continue standing'. The whole family belongs to PIE *sta-.
latinIntro.cn: 可靠的形式是 stare“站”、sistere“使站住”与 persistere“继续站住”。整个词族都属于原始印欧语 *sta-。

items.meaning: the fact or quality of continuing or lasting
items.meaningCN: 继续或持久的事实或品质（-ence 构成状态名词）
items.example: Her persistence eventually won the funding.
items.exampleCN: 她的坚持最终争取到了资助。

items.meaning: continuing firmly or lasting a long time
items.meaningCN: 坚持不懈的；持续时间长的（-ent 构成形容词）
items.exampleCN: 持续不断的雨取消了比赛。

items.meaning: in a continuing or stubborn manner
items.meaningCN: 持续地；固执地（-ly 构成副词）

items.meaning: a rarer form of persistence, chiefly technical
items.meaningCN: persistence 的较罕见形式，主要用于技术文献
items.example: The persistency of the pesticide was measured in soil.
items.exampleCN: 这种农药在土壤中的持久性被测定了。

items.meaning: not lasting long in the environment or in memory
items.meaningCN: 在环境中或内存中不长久留存的（non- 表示否定）
items.example: Non-persistent chemicals break down within weeks.
items.exampleCN: 非持久性化学品在几周内降解。

items.meaning: to continue doing something, often against advice
items.meaningCN: 继续做某事，常指不听劝（in 标记活动）
items.example: They persisted in asking for a written answer.
items.exampleCN: 他们执意要求一份书面答复。

items.meaning: to continue with a task or plan
items.meaningCN: 继续某项工作或计划（with 标记对象）
items.example: She persisted with the treatment for a full year.
items.exampleCN: 她坚持治疗了整整一年。

items.meaning: a person who keeps committing offences
items.meaningCN: 反复犯罪的人（法律术语）
items.example: He was classified as a persistent offender.

items.meaning: memory that keeps data after power is removed
items.meaningCN: 断电后仍保存数据的存储（计算机术语）
items.example: The logs are written to persistent storage.
items.exampleCN: 日志被写入持久化存储。

items.meaning: the way an image stays on the retina briefly and makes film appear to move
items.meaningCN: 图像在视网膜上短暂停留、使电影看起来在动的现象
items.example: Animation relies on the persistence of vision.

latinEntries.meaning: to cause to stand, place, stop

definition_zh: 坚持不懈的；执着的；持续的；连绵不断的；反复出现的；顽固的；难以消除的；持久性的；长期存续的
definition_en: continuing firmly despite difficulty, or continuing to exist, appear, or remain far longer than expected, whether of a person, a symptom, a smell, a chemical, or stored data
core_image: 那颗按钮被一直按着，所以灯始终亮着，谁也没能把它关掉
scene: 楼道尽头那盏灯坏了三个月还没修，每次经过都还亮着。The lamp at the end of the hall has been a persistent fault for three months.
sceneCN: 这里 persistent 是「反复出现的、挥之不去的」（第 3 个义项：问题一再出现、始终没有消失）；句意：走廊尽头那盏灯是个持续了三个月的反复故障；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 坚持不懈的；持续的；反复出现的；顽固的；持久性的

derivatives.zh: 坚持不懈；持续存在；持久性

senses.title: Refusing to give up
senses.definition: of a person, continuing firmly with an aim despite obstacles, rejection, or repeated failure
senses.definitionCN: 指人面对障碍、拒绝或反复失败仍坚定继续追求目标
senses.example: A persistent student kept coming back until the proof worked.
senses.exampleCN: 一个不肯放弃的学生一次次回来，直到证明走通。
senses.why: Persistent is the present participle of persistere, 'standing thoroughly'. The adjective describes the hand that has not lifted from the button, not the difficulty it faces.
senses.whyCN: persistent 是 persistere“彻底站住”的现在分词。这个形容词描述的是那只还没有离开按钮的手，而不是它面对的困难。

senses.title: Continuing without a break
senses.definition: of a condition, sound, or process, continuing over a long period without stopping
senses.definitionCN: 指状况、声音或过程在长时间内不断持续
senses.example: A persistent hum came from the transformer all night.
senses.exampleCN: 变压器的持续嗡鸣响了一整夜。
senses.why: Here the light simply stays on. No struggle and no praise: the adjective measures duration, and persistent becomes close to continuous.
senses.whyCN: 这里的灯只是持续亮着。没有挣扎也没有赞许：形容词衡量的是时长，persistent 因此接近 continuous。

senses.title: Coming back again and again
senses.definition: of a problem, symptom, rumour, or error, appearing repeatedly and refusing to go away
senses.definitionCN: 指问题、症状、传闻或错误反复出现、不肯消失
senses.example: The persistent leak was traced to a hairline crack.
senses.exampleCN: 这个反复出现的渗漏最终被追查到一条细裂缝。
senses.why: The button is being pressed again each time the fault returns. The adjective marks the repetition, not the length, which is why a persistent cough can be short and a persistent rumour can be old.
senses.whyCN: 每次故障回来，按钮就被再按一次。这个形容词标记的是重复而非长度，所以 persistent 的咳嗽可以很短，persistent 的传闻可以很旧。

senses.title: Hard to remove
senses.definition: of a stain, smell, habit, or stain-like thing, remaining despite attempts to remove or change it
senses.definitionCN: 指污渍、气味或习惯在试图去除或改变之后仍然存在
senses.example: A persistent smell of smoke stayed in the curtains for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 窗帘上的烟味挥之不去，持续了好几周。
senses.why: Some lamps cannot be switched off by ordinary means. This sense stresses resistance to cleaning or correction, with the same image of a light that keeps burning.
senses.whyCN: 有些灯用普通办法关不掉。这个义项强调对清洁或纠正的抵抗，意象仍是那盏一直烧着的灯。

senses.title: Remaining in the environment
senses.definition: of a chemical or pollutant, remaining in soil, water, or organisms for a long time without breaking down
senses.definitionCN: 指化学品或污染物在土壤、水体或生物体内长期存在而不分解
senses.example: Persistent pesticides accumulate up the food chain.
senses.exampleCN: 持久性农药会沿食物链逐级累积。
senses.why: Chemistry borrowed the duration sense and made it a measurable property. The lamp refuses to go out, and the measure of that refusal becomes an environmental warning.
senses.whyCN: 化学借用了持续义，并把它变成可测量的属性。灯拒绝熄灭，这种拒绝的程度就成了环境警告。

senses.title: Stored beyond the session
senses.definition: of data or an object in computing, remaining stored after a program, session, or device stops
senses.definitionCN: 指数据或对象在程序、会话或设备停止后仍被保存
senses.example: Persistent storage keeps the user's settings after a reboot.
senses.exampleCN: 持久化存储让用户的设置在重启后仍然保留。
senses.why: Memory loses its light when the power ends; persistent storage is built so the button is held by something slower and more permanent than electricity.
senses.whyCN: 内存断电就失去光；持久化存储的设计让按钮被某种比电更慢、更永久的东西按住。

senses.title: A symptom that will not settle
senses.definition: of a medical sign, infection, or pain, continuing longer than expected or returning after treatment
senses.definitionCN: 指医学体征、感染或疼痛持续超过预期，或治疗之后再次出现
senses.example: Persistent fever for more than a week needs investigation.
senses.exampleCN: 持续一周以上的发热需要进一步检查。
senses.why: The body's lamp stays lit after the illness should have ended. Medicine uses the adjective to separate a passing reaction from a state that has taken up residence.
senses.whyCN: 身体的灯在本该结束之后仍亮着。医学用这个形容词把一时的反应与已经“住下来”的状态分开。

senses.title: Refusing to be put off
senses.definition: of a person's manner, continuing to ask, demand, or appear despite hints that they should stop
senses.definitionCN: 指人的举止，在别人暗示应当停止时仍继续询问、要求或出现
senses.example: The persistent salesman called four times in one week.
senses.exampleCN: 那个纠缠不休的推销员一周打了四次电话。
senses.why: The same standing posture, now seen from the receiving side. Persistence is virtue when you want the goal; persistent is annoying when you are the obstacle.
senses.whyCN: 同一个站立的姿势，现在从被面对的一方来看。当目标是你要的，坚持是美德；当你就是障碍时，persistent 就很烦人。

senses.title: Lasting across generations
senses.definition: of a tradition, belief, species, or pattern, surviving over a very long period despite pressure to disappear
senses.definitionCN: 指传统、信念、物种或模式在消失的压力下仍长期存续
senses.example: The persistent custom survived two centuries of migration.
senses.exampleCN: 这个长存的习俗挺过了两个世纪的迁徙。
senses.why: The largest lamp again: a whole pattern stays lit. Persistent here is measured in generations, and the hand on the button is a community that keeps passing it on.
senses.whyCN: 又是最大的一盏灯：一整套模式持续亮着。这里的 persistent 以世代计量，按住按钮的是不断把它传下去的共同体。

intro.en: Persistent is the English adjective from Latin persistens, the present participle of persistere 'to stand firm, continue'. Persistere is per- 'thoroughly' plus sistere 'to stand'. The adjective entered English in the 16th century, first for persons and opinions, then spreading in the 19th and 20th centuries to symptoms, chemicals, and computer storage.
intro.cn: persistent 是来自拉丁语 persistens 的英语形容词，即 persistere“站稳、持续”的现在分词。persistere 是 per-“彻底”加 sistere“站立”。这个形容词在 16 世纪进入英语，最早用于人与意见，19 至 20 世纪扩展到症状、化学品与计算机存储。

items.en: Sistere 'to stand, to place' comes from the reconstructed PIE form *sta- 'to stand'. The prefix per- 'thoroughly' makes persistere 'to stand through to the end'.
items.cn: sistere“站立、放置”出自原始印欧语的重构形式 *sta-“站立”。前缀 per-“彻底”使 persistere 成为“站到最后”。

items.en: The present participle persistens, persistentem supplies English with both persistent and, through the noun persistentia, persistence. The two words entered English on parallel tracks rather than one from the other.
items.cn: 现在分词 persistens、persistentem 同时为英语提供 persistent 与（经名词 persistentia 的）persistence。这两个词是平行进入英语的，而不是一个由另一个派生。

items.en: English persistent first describes people and opinions that hold their ground. The tone can be admiring or critical depending on the sentence.
items.cn: 英语 persistent 最早描述守住立场的人与意见。语气可褒可贬，取决于句子。

items.en: Medicine and chemistry adopt it for symptoms and substances that stay: persistent fever, persistent odour, persistent dyes.
items.cn: 19 世纪医学与化学用它描述滞留的症状与物质：持续发热、挥之不去的气味、不易褪色的染料。

items.en: Computing adds persistent storage and persistent connections; environmental science fixes the phrase persistent organic pollutants.
items.cn: 20 世纪计算机加入持久化存储与持久连接；环境科学固定了“持久性有机污染物”这一说法。

items.en: Perseverant looks like a twin but comes from perseverare, a different Latin verb. Persistent is the participle of persistere; the two overlap in meaning without sharing a formation.
items.cn: perseverant 看起来像双胞胎，却来自另一个拉丁动词 perseverare。persistent 是 persistere 的分词；两者意义重叠，构词却不同。

note.en: The first group separates the adjective from its noun family and from two near neighbours built differently. The second group compares continual, continuous, stubborn, and lingering.
note.cn: 第一组把形容词与其名词词族分开，并区分两个构词不同的近邻。第二组比较 continual、continuous、stubborn、lingering。

entries.definition: the state of standing firm or continuing. It names the quality; persistent describes the thing that has it.
entries.definitionCN: 站稳或持续的状态。它命名品质，persistent 描述具有该品质的事物。

entries.definition: to continue firmly or keep existing. It is the verb behind the participle.
entries.definitionCN: 坚定继续或持续存在。它是分词背后的动词。

entries.definition: steadfast in a course of action, from Latin perseverare. It overlaps in meaning but is not the participle of persistere.
entries.definitionCN: 在行动道路上坚定不移的，出自拉丁 perseverare。意义重叠，却不是 persistere 的分词。

entries.definition: to stand against. It shares sistere 'stand' but points the posture in the opposite direction.
entries.definitionCN: 站在对立面；抵抗。它共享 sistere“站立”，却把姿势指向相反方向。

entries.definition: happening repeatedly over a period, often with interruptions. It fits a recurring cough or complaint better than an unbroken hum.
entries.definitionCN: 在一段时间内反复发生，常有中断。它更适合反复的咳嗽或抱怨，而不是不间断的嗡鸣。

entries.definition: going on without any interruption. It covers the unbroken hum and the unbroken line, but not the stubborn person.
entries.definitionCN: 没有任何中断地持续。它适用于不间断的嗡鸣与不断的线，却不适用于固执的人。

entries.definition: unwilling to change one's attitude or course. It is the personal sense of persistent, usually with disapproval.
entries.definitionCN: 不愿改变态度或方向。它是 persistent 的个人义，通常带不赞成的语气。

entries.definition: remaining slowly after the cause has gone, as a smell or doubt. It stresses the slowness of departure rather than the strength of staying.
entries.definitionCN: 在成因消失后缓慢地残留，如气味或疑虑。它强调离开得慢，而不是留得有力。

normalIntro.en: Real pieces only: sistere 'stand', per- 'thoroughly', the participle persistens, the 16th-century entry, and the parallel noun persistence.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：sistere“站立”、per-“彻底”、分词 persistens、16 世纪的进入，以及平行的名词 persistence。

normal.en: Persistent is the standing participle: someone or something is standing thoroughly in place, and has not lifted the hand.
normal.cn: persistent 是“站立”的分词：某人或某物彻底站在原地，还没有把手拿开。

normal.en: It entered English in the 16th century for people, then moved to fevers, smells, and chemicals that also refuse to leave.
normal.cn: 它在 16 世纪先用于人，后来转到同样不肯离开的发热、气味与化学品。

normal.en: Persistent and persistence came into English on parallel tracks from the same Latin verb, not one from the other.
normal.cn: persistent 与 persistence 是从同一个拉丁动词平行进入英语的，并不是一个由另一个派生。

normal.en: Continual means repeated with gaps; continuous means without a break; persistent can mean either, depending on what it describes.
normal.cn: continual 指有间隔的重复；continuous 指没有中断；persistent 视所修饰的对象，两者都可以指。

normal.en: The same word praises a student and complains about a salesman; only the sentence decides which reading wins.
normal.cn: 同一个词既赞美学生，也抱怨推销员；只有句子能决定哪一种读法胜出。

abstract.en: A lamp that stays on after everyone has left is either a comfort or a waste, depending on who is paying.
abstract.cn: 所有人都离开后还亮着的灯，可能是安慰，也可能是浪费，取决于谁付电费。

abstract.en: A rumour is persistent because it asks nothing of the people who repeat it.
abstract.cn: 传闻之所以挥之不去，是因为它对传播它的人毫无要求。

abstract.en: A tradition survives by being boring enough to repeat and useful enough to keep.
abstract.cn: 传统之所以存续，是因为它无聊到可以重复，又有用到值得保留。

examples.en: The persistent noise from the fridge turned out to be a loose fan.
examples.cn: 冰箱那持续不断的噪音，最后查出来是风扇松了。

examples.en: Persistent organic pollutants travel thousands of kilometres.
examples.cn: 持久性有机污染物会迁移数千公里。

examples.en: She was persistent enough to get the archive opened after hours.
examples.cn: 她够执着，让档案馆在下班后重新开门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「破西斯特恩特」——破了阻力还“死”站着不走，像钉子一样钉在原地 → persistent 坚持不懈的；持续不退的（只借音，不表词源）

root: 拉丁 persistens，即 persistere「站稳、持续」的现在分词，由 per-「彻底」+ sistere「站立」构成（*sta-「站立」词根）；后缀 -ent 为拉丁分词词尾。核心是「按钮一直被按着，灯始终亮着」。同族含 persist、persistence、persistently；perseverant 出自另一动词 perseverare。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of persistent all describe a lamp that stays lit. What changes is what keeps it burning: a person's will, a condition's duration, a fault's return, a stain's resistance, a chemical's half-life, a disk, a symptom, a salesman, or a tradition.
sensesIntro.cn: persistent 的九个义项都描述一盏持续亮着的灯。变化的是谁让它烧着：人的意志、状况的时长、故障的回归、污渍的抵抗、化学品的半衰期、一块磁盘、一个症状、一个推销员，还是一项传统。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a button held down so the lamp stays lit, and no ordinary attempt can switch it off.
core.cn: 核心意象：按钮被一直按着，灯始终亮着，普通的办法都关不掉。

branches.en: THE HOLDING PERSON: the admiring and the annoying readings of the same upright posture.
branches.cn: 按住的人：同一个挺立姿势的赞美读法与烦人读法。

branches.en: THE STUBBORN LIGHT: unbroken duration, repeated return, and resistance to removal.
branches.cn: 倔强的光：不间断的时长、反复的回归，以及对去除的抵抗。

branches.en: TECHNICAL STAYING: pollutants that will not break down, and data that survives a restart.
branches.cn: 技术性的停留：不分解的污染物，以及挺过重启的数据。

branches.en: THE BODY: a fever or infection that outlasts its expected course.
branches.cn: 身体：超过预期病程的发热或感染。

branches.en: THE LONGEST LIGHT: a custom or species carried across generations.
branches.cn: 最长的光：跨越世代被传下去的习惯或物种。

intro.en: Persistent is persist plus -ent, the Latin present-participle ending. Persist is persistere, per- 'thoroughly' + sistere 'stand'. The family includes the noun persistence, the adverb persistently, and the sistere clan: assist, insist, resist, consist.
intro.cn: persistent 是 persist 加 -ent，即拉丁现在分词词尾。persist 是 persistere，即 per-“彻底”+ sistere“站立”。词族包含名词 persistence、副词 persistently，以及 sistere 家族：assist、insist、resist、consist。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is sistere 'stand', persistere 'stand firm', and the participle persistens. The root *sta- 'stand' also gives English stand, stable, station, and statue.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁层是 sistere“站立”、persistere“站稳”、分词 persistens。词根 *sta-“站立”还产生英语 stand（站立）、stable（稳固）、station（站点）与 statue（雕像）。

definition_zh: 个人的；私人的；亲自的；涉及私生活的；人称的
definition_en: relating to one particular person rather than to others, or done by that person directly
core_image: 一只抽屉拉开一道缝，里面是只属于一个人的旧照片、钥匙和一封没寄出的信
scene: 搬家那天，纸箱上写着同一个名字，里面装着相册、旧信和一只用了多年的杯子，都是不打算与人分享的东西。She keeps her personal letters in a locked drawer.
sceneCN: 这里是「个人的、私人的」（第 1 个义项：属于某一个人而非公共的）；句意为她把私人信件锁在抽屉里。画面里那只抽屉只为一个名字打开。
